warnings: "vault-chair" extends outside the safe area in the final frame (x 837…1024, y 585…780)

review.verdict: The paper-cutout style is consistent and the robot-for-AI casting is correct, but the two-panel structure collapses into one blurry scene: there's no visible divider, the vault-chair prop is clipped off the safe area, the prescription pad floats oddly rather than being held, and the two robots are too similar to tell the doctor scenario from the bank scenario — this doesn't clear the bar.
revisionNotes: Add the visible vertical divider line from the scene spec — it's not reading in the render, so the two panels blend into one continuous scene instead of the two-panel structure the brief calls for.
The "vault-chair" component is clipped by the right edge per the lint warning (x 837…1024, y 585…780); shift it left toward x≈0.78 or scale it down to 0.8 so it sits fully inside the safe area.

Split "vault-chair" into two separate props: an open vault door (angled, dark interior visible) and a distinct guard's chair silhouette beside it — right now they're fused into one blob that reads as a filing cabinet, not a heist scene.

Attach the prescription pad directly into the doctor robot's hand (arms prop "holding"), not floating behind its head on an offset — it currently looks like a sticky note stuck to the head rather than a held prop.

Give the doctor robot a visible white-coat layer (e.g. a body-alt panel or collar shape) so it reads distinctly from the vault robot; right now the two robots are near-identical twins and the two scenarios don't visually differentiate.
Strengthen the stethoscope-on-stool read — the red loop shape is subtle at this scale; thicken the stroke or enlarge scale to ~1.2 so "empty doctor's seat" registers quickly.

review.verdict: Correctly casts robots as the AI systems and lands a fresh paper-cutout look, but execution bugs undercut the joke: the coat/pad floats disconnected above the robot's head, the stethoscope reads as a spill, and the vault robot never actually reaches into the vault as the brief requires — average falls below the pass bar.
revisionNotes: The coat-and-pad element floats above the left robot's head as a disconnected white arrow with a pad beside it — reattach it to the robot's chest/hand at a lower offset so it reads as a worn coat collar and a held prescription pad, not a hovering shape.
The stool's accent swirl reads as a dripping red stain down the leg rather than a coiled stethoscope — redraw it as a clear coil anchored flat on the seat with a distinct round chestpiece.

Per the brief, the vault robot should be 'reaching into' the vault; current pose has arms down and it just stands beside a closed box — extend one arm forward into the vault opening so the theft beat reads.
Vault door renders as a flat dark rectangle, easy to mistake for a locker or closet — add a visible dial or hinge marks and a lighter frame so 'bank vault' is legible at a glance.
Guard chair (scale 0.7) is tiny and silhouette-similar to the doctor's stool — scale it to ~0.9 and give it a back/armrest shape so the two empty seats are visually distinct.

The 'single warm red accent light' called out in the brief to tie the panels together isn't legible as one device — right now the red bits read as separate props (pad dot, stool stain, vault light); make one small glowing dot a repeated shared motif in both panels.

review.verdict: Clever "no supervisor" concept with correctly-cast robots and empty seats, but the prescription pad and reaching arms cross the center divider and fuse the two panels together, the vault reads as a screen rather than a vault, the guard chair is stranded in a corner, and the vertical-divider two-robot layout closely echoes a recent slopper — falls short of publish-ready.
revisionNotes: Pull robot-doctor's arm and the prescription-pad prop back inside the left panel (reduce offset/x on 'coat-and-pad') — right now the pad's arrow tip crosses the divider and visually fuses with the vault, making two separate incidents read as one interaction.

The white coat is unreadable: the collar shape attached to robot-doctor is tiny and blends into the torso. Make it a clear layered 'r-paper' coat silhouette over the chest/shoulders at scale ~1.2 so it reads as a doctor's coat, not a generic robot panel.

guard-chair is stranded in the far bottom-right corner, disconnected from the vault by a lot of empty green. Move it to roughly x=0.83, y=0.74 right next to vault-door so it reads as 'the empty seat beside the vault.'

vault-door currently reads like a screen/ATM (flat dark rectangle) rather than a bank vault. Make the circular dial/wheel prop larger and more central (scale 1.3, kind 'tank'), and darken the opening so the 'ajar' interior is obvious.

Two robots split by a thin vertical divider is nearly the same composition as a recent slopper (robots-with-'Records'-divider piece); change the panel treatment — stagger the horizon line or vary scale between panels — and shift the palette off teal/cream to differentiate.
Keep robot-vault's reaching hand from touching robot-doctor's hand at the centerline; stop the arm short of the divider so each panel stays visually self-contained.
